#!/bin/bash

# Script to load all seed events from JSON files into ClickHouse
echo "Loading seed events into ClickHouse..."

cd /workspace/moose-project

# Process each JSON file
for file in /data/events/evt_*.json; do
  echo "Processing $file..."

  # Read the JSON and extract fields
  event_data=$(cat "$file")
  event_id=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -r '.event_id')
  event_ts=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -r '.event_ts')
  user_id=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -r '.user_id')
  product_id=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -r '.product_id')
  event_type=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -r '.event_type')
  properties=$(echo "$event_data" | jq -c '.properties')

  # Convert ISO timestamp to ClickHouse format
  formatted_ts=$(echo "$event_ts" | sed 's/T/ /' | sed 's/Z/.000/')

  # Insert into ClickHouse
  moose query "INSERT INTO ProductEvent VALUES (
    '$event_id',
    '$formatted_ts',
    '$user_id',
    '$product_id',
    '$event_type',
    '$properties'
  )"

  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "✓ Loaded $event_id"
  else
    echo "✗ Failed to load $event_id"
  fi
done

echo "Seed data loading completed!"
echo "Total events in table:"
moose query "SELECT count() FROM ProductEvent"
